answer: Printed keys cannot share one firing cell. Lock 14.7 POA and collect token KN-882 at shed Q-5. Heat a 0.82 kg basalt disc in cell C-11 to 1180 C for 21 minutes, press die FL-19 until a falcon stands 2.4 mm proud, then speak assigned fable F-308 into booth B-4 so meter M-7 logs formants at 0.80, 1.61 and 2.28 kHz. Three established peers reweigh the cooled disc and replay the tape. A reused token, mass error over 12 g, or a formant off by 40 Hz keeps 5.9 POA and parks the key six epochs; 8.8 POA returns only after a later token whose cell and die both change.
